# Анализ эффективности
## Интенсивность боли по ВАШ (в покое)

```{r VAS_prep}
prep_VAS <- raw_data %>% 
  select(c(contains("VAS"), USUBJID, ARM)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("V"),
    names_to = c("VISIT", "CONDITION"),
    names_pattern = "(V\\d)_PAIN_VAS(.*)",
    values_to = "VALUE")

bl_VAS <- prep_VAS %>% 
  filter(VISIT=="V1") %>% 
  mutate(BLVALUE=VALUE) %>% 
  select(-c(VISIT, VALUE, ARM))


final_VAS <- prep_VAS %>% 
  left_join(bl_VAS, join_by(USUBJID, CONDITION)) %>% 
  mutate(BLFL=ifelse(VISIT=="V1", 1, 0),
         CHVALUE=ifelse(BLFL==0, BLVALUE-VALUE, NA_real_),
         VISIT=as.factor(VISIT))

final_VAS_total <- rbind(final_VAS, mutate(final_VAS, ARM = "Total"))

```


```{r VAS_rest}
library(flextable)
globaldec <- ","
globaldig <- 2

f_num <- function(x, dig = globaldig, dec = globaldec, p = FALSE, pre = "", suf = "") {
        n <- formatC(x, digits = dig, decimal.mark = dec, format = "f")
        n <- ifelse(p == TRUE & x < 0.001, paste0("<0", dec, strrep("0", dig-1), "1"), n)
        n <- ifelse(p == TRUE & x == 1, paste0(">0", dec, strrep("9", dig)), n)
        n <- paste0(pre, n, suf)
        return(n)
}

statlist <- c(
        `Количество наблюдений` = "nbr.val",
        `Среднее (СО)` = "mean.std",
        `97.5% ДИ` = "CI.mean",
        `Медиана (Q1; Q3)` = "median.q1.q3",
        `Минимум – Максимум` = "minmax")

sumnum <- function(x, stats = statlist, conflev=.975)
{
        std <- stat.desc(as.numeric(x), p=conflev)
        
        CI.L  <- std["mean"] - std["CI.mean.0.975"]
        CI.U  <- std["mean"] + std["CI.mean.0.975"]
        
        Q.L <- quantile(x, probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
        Q.U <- quantile(x, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        std <- c(std, CI.L = CI.L, CI.U = CI.U, Q.L = Q.L, Q.U = Q.U)
        
        std[-c(1:3)] <- f_num(std[-c(1:3)])
        
        std <- gsub(pattern = ".*N.*|.*I.*", replacement = "-", std)
        
        std["mean.std"] = paste0(std["mean"], " (", std["std.dev"], ")")
        std["CI.mean"] = paste(std["CI.L.mean"], std["CI.U.mean"], sep = " - ")
        std["median.q1.q3"] = paste0(std["median"], " (", paste(std["Q.L.25%"], std["Q.U.75%"], sep = "; "), ")")
        std["minmax"] = paste(std["min"], std["max"], sep = " - ")

        std <- std[stats] %>% rbind() %>% as.data.frame() 
        colnames(std) <- names(stats)
        
        return(std)
}

describe_num <- function (data, idvar, grvar, visvar, grcodes, 
                          varcodes, varnames, visits, total = NULL, 
                          col_name=varnames) {
        dat <- data %>%
                as.data.frame() %>% 
                select(all_of(c(ID = idvar, GROUP = grvar, VISIT = visvar)), all_of(varcodes))
        
        # Суммарные данные
        if (!is.null(total)) dat <- rbind(dat, mutate(dat, GROUP = factor(total)))
        
        # Расчет описательной статистики
        ltbl <- dat %>%
                complete(GROUP, VISIT) %>%
                filter(VISIT %in% visits) %>%
                mutate(across(.cols = all_of(varcodes), .fns = as.numeric)) %>% 
                pivot_longer(cols = all_of(varcodes), names_to = "VAR", values_to = "VAL", 
                             names_transform = list(VAR = fct_inorder)) %>% 
                mutate(VAL = as.numeric(VAL), VISIT = droplevels(VISIT)) %>%
                group_by(VAR, VISIT, GROUP) %>%
                do(sumnum(.$VAL)) # sumnum.R
        
        # Набор данных с описательной статистикой
        ttbl <- ltbl %>% 
                pivot_longer(cols = c(-VAR, -VISIT, - GROUP), names_to = "PARAM", values_to = "VAL", 
                             names_transform = list(PARAM = fct_inorder)) %>% 
                arrange(VAR, VISIT, GROUP, PARAM) %>% 
                ungroup() %>% 
                mutate(VAR = case_when(VAR=={{varcodes}}~{{col_name}}), 
                       VAR = factor(VAR, levels = varnames))
        
        return(ttbl)
}


idvar <- "USUBJID" 
grvar <- "ARM" 
visvar <- "VISIT"
grcodes <- c("Траумель"="Traumeel", "Диклофенак"="Diclofenac")
vis_codes <- c("Визит 1\n(исходный уровень"="V1",
               "Визит 2"="V2",

            "Визит 2",
```

```{r VAS_rest}
my_data <- final_VAS %>% filter(CONDITION=="REST") %>% mutate(ARM=fct_relevel(ARM, "Traumeel", "Diclofenac"))

varcodes <- "VALUE" 
varnames <- "Наблюдаемое значение" 
res_obs <- describe_num(my_data, idvar, grvar, visvar, grcodes, 
                    varcodes, varnames, visits, total = "Все пациенты", 
                    col_name="Наблюдаемое значение")

varcodes <- "CHVALUE" 
varnames <- "Изменение от исходного уровня" 
res_ch <- describe_num(my_data, idvar, grvar, visvar, grcodes, 
                    varcodes, varnames, visits, total = "Все пациенты", 
                    col_name="Изменение от исходного уровня") %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(VAL=ifelse(VISIT=="V1", "-", VAL)) %>% 
  ungroup()

t_test_result_v2 <- t.test(CHVALUE ~ ARM, data = subset(my_data, VISIT=="V2"), var.equal = T, conf.level=.975, alternative = "greater", mu=-6.5)$p.value

t_test_result_v3 <- t.test(CHVALUE ~ ARM, data = subset(my_data, VISIT=="V3"), var.equal = T, conf.level=.975, alternative = "greater", mu=-6.5)$p.value
glimpse(my_data)
t.test(CHVALUE ~ ARM, data = subset(my_data, VISIT=="V3"), var.equal = T, conf.level=.975, alternative = "greater", mu=-6.5)$conf.int

library(broom)
result_df <- t.test(CHVALUE ~ ARM, data = subset(my_data, VISIT=="V3"), var.equal = T, conf.level=.975, alternative = "greater", mu=-6.5) %>%
  tidy() %>%
  mutate(
    ci_formatted = sprintf("%.1f - %.1f", conf.low, conf.high)
  ) %>%
  select(estimate, p.value, ci_formatted)

result <- t.test(CHVALUE ~ ARM, data = subset(my_data, VISIT=="V3"), var.equal = T, conf.level=.975, alternative = "greater", mu=-6.5) %>%
  tidy() %>%
  mutate(
    # Форматируем: Оценка (Нижняя - Верхняя)
    formatted_output = sprintf("%.1f (97.5%% ДИ %.1f - %.1f)", 
                               estimate, conf.low, conf.high)
  )

results <- my_data %>%
  filter(VISIT!="V1") %>% 
  group_by(VISIT) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    ttest = map(data, ~t.test(CHVALUE ~ ARM, data = .x, conf.level = 0.975, alternative = "greater", mu=-6.5) %>% tidy())
  ) %>%
  unnest(ttest) %>%
  mutate(
    `Оценка (97.5% ДИ)` = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f - %.1f)", estimate, conf.low, conf.high)
  ) %>%
  mutate(VISIT = case_match(VISIT,
                            "V2" ~ "Между визитами 1 и 2",
                            "V3" ~ "Между визитами 1 и 3",
                            .default = VISIT),
         `p-value`=round(p.value, 3) %>% as.character(),
         estimate1=round(estimate1, 2),
         estimate2=round(estimate2, 2)
         ) %>% 
  select(VISIT, `p-value`, `Оценка (97.5% ДИ)`, estimate1, estimate2) %>%
  rename(`Траумель`=estimate1, `Диклофенак`=estimate2, `Изменение интенсивности боли по ВАШ (мм)`=VISIT) %>%
```
